name: The Plan to Save the King of Denmark's Drama Club
source:
The King of Denmark's drama club is one failed performance away from being shut down. No second chances.

However, Jean knows exactly how to save it. The problem is nobody asked him.

Passed over for the lead role he was born to play, watching his closest friend step into the spotlight he's always wanted, Jean must decide what kind of person he's going to be. The club is fracturing, the budget is gone, and coincidentally, an impossibly energetic girl has appeared with a plan of her own.

What will Jean do when the role of a lifetime isn't the one he rehearsed?

[From [url=https://waltitow.itch.io/the-plan-to-save-the-king-of-denmarks-drama-club]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
丹麦国王的戏剧俱乐部如果演出失败，就会被关闭。没有第二次机会。

然而，吉恩清楚地知道如何拯救它。问题是没人问他。

吉恩错过了生来就该扮演的主角，看着他最亲密的朋友步入他一直想要的聚光灯下，吉恩必须决定他要成为什么样的人。俱乐部正在破裂，预算也消失了，巧合的是，一个精力充沛的女孩带着她自己的计划出现了。

当让一生难忘的角色不是他排练的角色时，他会怎么做？

[来自[url=https://waltitow.itch.io/the-plan-to-save-the-king-of-denmarks-drama-club]itch.io[/url]]
